format.note: 22 rounds home and away, rounds 23-33 a third meeting with each opponent, then Section A (1st-6th) and Section B (7th-12th) play their five rivals once more

playoff.note: 11th plays the Championship runner-up over two legs for the last Premiership place; 12th is relegated directly

format.note: new 16-club format in 2026-27: double round-robin of 30 rounds, then Section A (1st-8th) and Section B (9th-16th) play seven more

playoff.note: champion promoted directly; runner-up meets the Premiership 11th over two legs

boundaries.note: Championship champion goes up directly, runner-up plays the Premiership 11th over two legs for the last place; 12th in the Premiership goes down directly. The play-off is shared, so exactly one of {11th, Championship runner-up} is in the top flight next season.

notes: Sizes and levels match our rows: 12 and 16. 2026-27 is the first Championship season with 16 clubs (expanded from 12; four promoted from the Premier Intermediate League and none relegated in 2025-26 because of the expansion), so history seeded from 2025-26 will show a 12-club second tier and is not comparable. Premiership: 38 matches per club (22 + 11 + 5 split), Section A/B after round 33. Championship: 37 matches (30 + 7 split), Section A/B after 30, champion promoted, 16th relegated to the NCL Premier (level 3, not modelled) and 15th in a play-off against the NCL Premier runner-up - hence closed_down for NIR2. No regional split at either level.
